assumptions.choice: Track weekly cadence by counting ISO calendar-week transitions on the daily feed (increment a week counter whenever date().isocalendar()[:2] changes) instead of actually resampling to weekly bars.
assumptions.reason: Cerebro/data-feed setup, including any resampling, is fixed by the harness; only the single daily self.data feed is available, so true weekly resampling of the spec's 'working timeframe' cannot be added.

assumptions.choice: Implement only the entry -> rebalance-every-12-weeks -> exit-at-52-weeks trading rule as one continuous run over the fixed dataset, with the first cycle starting on the first bar and each subsequent cycle chained immediately after the prior cycle's exit.
assumptions.reason: The spec's testing protocol (50 random start dates, one independent backtest per date, then averaging Total Return/Max Drawdown/Sharpe across runs) requires launching many separate backtests and reporting aggregated statistics. The harness runs exactly one Strategy over one fixed cerebro instance and forbids any executing/printing/top-level code outside the strategy class, so multi-run random sampling and cross-run metric averaging cannot be implemented here.

assumptions.choice: Size each buy as floor(available_cash / (signal-bar close * 1.001)), i.e. as much of current cash as fits after the 0.1% commission.
assumptions.reason: The spec explicitly calls for 100% portfolio allocation on entry and at every rebalance, which is a stated sizing rule (not covered by the plain-buy canonical default), so size must be computed from available cash rather than left to the default sizer.

assumptions.choice: The close-then-reopen at each rebalance/cycle transition is submitted as two sequential orders (close, then buy once the close fills) rather than an intra-bar simultaneous close+reopen.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader's default broker fills market orders on a following bar, not instantaneously within the same next() call; true same-instant close-and-reopen is not available in this environment.
